title: 2026 freight-land scope and HGV load QA controls

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Freight-land factors cover road and rail transport of goods.
Scope 1 delivery-vehicle factors apply to vehicles owned or controlled by the reporting organisation.
Scope 3 freighting factors apply to goods moved over land by third parties.
Scope 3 freight factors are available for whole vehicle loads and per tonne of goods shipped.
WTT factors are relevant to both owned delivery vehicles and third-party freight transport.
Managed-asset factors cover vans/LGVs and HGVs.
There were no major freight-land methodological changes in the 2026 update.
HGV factors use DfT road-freight survey information for GB rigid and articulated vehicles.
HGV fuel-consumption data are converted to gCO2/km using the standard 2026 diesel fuel factor.
HGV load affects per-km emissions, with load effects proportionally greater for heavier HGV classes.
